<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the upfield signals (≈10‑35 ppm) correspond to methyl carbons. The spectrum shows peaks at 34.53 ppm (appearing twice, indicating two distinct methyl carbons), 22.80 ppm, 21.35 ppm, and 19.20 ppm. This accounts for a total of five methyl carbon signals, meaning the molecule contains five CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
